rules.description: Ensures order date is not in the future.

impact.reason: Future dates indicate data entry or timing errors affecting reporting.
Negative subtotal is unrealistic for sales data.
Negative shipping fees are not business‑logical.

rules.description: Total amount charged to the customer must be non‑negative.

impact.reason: Negative charges indicate calculation or data errors.

rules.rule: (orders.items_subtotal IS NULL OR orders.shipping_fee IS NULL OR orders.order_discount IS NULL) OR (orders.order_discount <= orders.items_subtotal + orders.shipping_fee)
rules.description: Discount cannot exceed the sum of items subtotal and shipping fee.

impact.reason: Excessive discounts could produce invalid negative totals.

rules.rule: (orders.items_subtotal IS NULL OR orders.shipping_fee IS NULL OR orders.order_discount IS NULL OR orders.total_amount IS NULL) OR (orders.total_amount = orders.items_subtotal + orders.shipping_fee - orders.order_discount)
rules.description: Total amount must equal subtotal plus shipping fee minus discount.

impact.reason: Core financial consistency; mismatches break revenue calculations.
